description: This file defines the interface 'FormProcessorInterface' in the 'Goteo\Library\Forms' namespace, specifying methods for form processing related to the Goteo project.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Creates and returns a new form object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the form data, with optional force save and form parameter.

methods.name: setBuilder
methods.description: Sets the form builder instance used to construct the form.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Returns the current form builder instance.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the form object, as indicated by the @return annotation.

methods.name: setModel
methods.description: Associates a data model with the form processor.

methods.name: setReadonly
methods.description: Sets readonly status for the form.

methods.name: setFullValidation
methods.description: Configures full validation and error display options.
